headline: Plan for State Park Entry and Coastal Parking Reservations
reservation: Delaware State Parks require vehicle entrance fees; specific drive-on surf fishing permits are limited and managed via a seasonal lottery or cap. Popular beach towns like Rehoboth utilize metered parking systems that fluctuate in demand; always verify current access policies and permit requirements on the official Delaware State Parks website before arrival.

days.title: Maritime History and Dunes

stops.name: Cape Henlopen State Park
stops.detail: Visit the WWII observation tower for panoramic views and explore the Great Dune, the highest sand dune in the state.

stops.name: Zwaanendael Museum
stops.detail: Learn about the region's Dutch colonial roots and maritime heritage in a building modeled after the Hoorn town hall.

days.driving: Allow 30–60 minutes for local transit; conditions vary with summer congestion.
days.note: State park entry points may reach capacity on holiday weekends.

days.title: Boardwalk Culture and Bays

stops.name: Rehoboth Beach Boardwalk
stops.detail: Walk the mile-long traditional wooden boardwalk for ocean views and local boutiques.

stops.name: Rehoboth Bay
stops.detail: Access the calmer inland waters for kayaking or paddleboarding away from the Atlantic surf.

days.driving: Allow 20–40 minutes; expect significant parking search times in town centers.
days.note: Check local ordinances for seasonal dog and bicycle restrictions on the boardwalk.

days.title: Quiet Resorts and Inlet Views

stops.name: Delaware Seashore State Park
stops.detail: Walk the Indian River Inlet Bridge for views of the Atlantic meeting the inland bays.

stops.name: Bethany Beach Nature Center
stops.detail: Explore forested wetlands and inland trails to see the local coastal ecology.

days.driving: Allow 45–60 minutes; Highway 1 traffic varies significantly by time of day.
days.note: Inlet areas can have high winds; check weather forecasts for bridge walking safety.

intel.title: Metered Beach Access
intel.text: Rehoboth and Bethany utilize mobile-app based metering; expect lots to fill by mid-morning during peak summer months.

intel.title: Coastal Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular service is generally stable in towns but may become intermittent in the deep marsh areas of Prime Hook.

intel.title: Highway 1 Services
intel.text: Fuel stations are frequent along the main Highway 1 corridor; services are more limited once inside State Park boundaries.

intel.title: Second Summer
intel.text: September offers warm water with fewer crowds; many seasonal concessions begin reducing hours after Labor Day.

intel.title: State Park Permits
intel.text: Vehicle access to specific beach strands requires a surf fishing permit; pedestrians can access most areas via designated crossovers.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at Ocean City (OCE) or arrive via Highway 1; Lewes offers a central base for historic district check-ins.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for paved roads; check rental agreements for restrictions on unpaved park access or sand.
plan.goldenHour: The Point at Cape Henlopen offers expansive sunset views; specific timing varies by season.
